\\Omega: the set of all permutations of \([n]\)
x_i: the element in position i of a permutation of [n]
I_j(\\pi): the set consisting of the first \(j\) entries of \(\pi\), with \(I_0(\pi)=\varnothing\)
j: an integer index satisfying 0 <= j < m
k: the cardinality |A| of a fixed member A of \mathcal A, or an arbitrary integer index between 0 and n where explicitly quantified
\\mathcal B: the family of all m-element subsets of [n]
\\mathcal A: the family of subsets appearing in the theorem statement
P_A: the set of permutations of \([n]\) whose first \(k_A\) elements form \(A\)
P: the incidence set of pairs \((A,\pi)\) such that \(A\in\mathcal A\) lies in \(C_\pi\)
s: The cardinality of a larger initial segment of a permutation.
S_n: the set of all permutations of \([n]\)
C_\\pi: the maximal chain consisting of the initial segments of \(\pi\)
B_1: a member of mathcal B used in the antichain check
B_2: a member of mathcal B used in the antichain check
